import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototypes
gsl.gsl_ran_fdist.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_ran_fdist.restype = ctypes.c_double

gsl.gsl_ran_fdist_pdf.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_ran_fdist_pdf.restype = ctypes.c_double

gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

gsl.gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
gsl.gsl_rng_free.restype = None

gsl.gsl_rng_env_setup.argtypes = []
gsl.gsl_rng_env_setup.restype = None

gsl.gsl_rng_default = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, 'gsl_rng_default')

def compute_fdist(rng, nu1, nu2):
    """Compute the F-distribution random variate and its PDF."""
    # Compute the F-distribution random variate
    f_value = gsl.gsl_ran_fdist(rng, nu1, nu2)
    # Compute the probability density function
    pdf_value = gsl.gsl_ran_fdist_pdf(f_value, nu1, nu2)
    return f_value, pdf_value

    """Run assertion tests to validate the solution."""
    # Initialize the random number generator
    gsl.gsl_rng_env_setup()
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl.gsl_rng_default)

    try:
        # Test cases
        nu1, nu2 = 5.0, 10.0
        f_value, pdf_value = compute_fdist(rng, nu1, nu2)
        assert isinstance(f_value, float), 'F-distribution value should be a float'
        assert isinstance(pdf_value, float), 'PDF value should be a float'
        assert f_value >= 0, 'F-distribution value should be non-negative'
        assert pdf_value >= 0, 'PDF value should be non-negative'

        nu1, nu2 = 15.0, 20.0
        f_value, pdf_value = compute_fdist(rng, nu1, nu2)
        assert isinstance(f_value, float), 'F-distribution value should be a float'
        assert isinstance(pdf_value, float), 'PDF value should be a float'
        assert f_value >= 0, 'F-distribution value should be non-negative'
        assert pdf_value >= 0, 'PDF value should be non-negative'

    finally:
        # Free the random number generator
        gsl.gsl_rng_free(rng)
